h: The Ark Leads Fallen Attributes Toward Shabbos Rest

p: "And they journeyed from the mountain of Hashem
and the Ark of the covenant of Hashem
to seek out a resting place for them" (Bamidbar 10:33).
And Rashi, of blessed memory, explained
And to understand what the pasuk alludes to in this:
כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה ה׳ וְגוֹ׳
and it does not say "in six";
and as it says in the holy Zohar too
"In sukkos you shall dwell seven days";
"And Avraham was old, advanced in days."
And we have already spoken of this,
to the aspect of the three holy Avos,
which are the totality of a person's life
that love be only in holiness;
the aspect of jealousy and anger,
"in the fear of Hashem all day,"
to be a mighty one who conquers his inclination;
the aspect of honor and self-exaltation,
"I am too small for all the kindnesses."
of the whole of Torah and service;
are only an extension of them.
"And they journeyed from the mountain of Hashem
that they turned away from following Hashem;
like a child running away from school.
that after the giving of the Torah
in all three attributes mentioned above,
And that is what is said after this
what befell all of Klal Yisrael,
and some trace touched even the great ones.
in the name of the Ibn Ezra,
that it is from the word aven, iniquity,
and it does not say which iniquity.
anger and grievances in the heart;
it says "evil in the eyes of Hashem,"
and about thoughts and grievances in the heart
"evil in the ears of Hashem" applies.
and put away evil from your flesh."
that He brought them to a desolate wilderness.
And for this was their punishment:
"And the fire of Hashem burned among them"
for what branches out of anger is fire,
"This is the anger and wrath of the gall,
the fire of Gehinnom is kindled."
"And it consumed at the edge of the camp"
among the distinguished ones of the camp,
a trace of the blemish the great ones,
"And the rabble that was among them
that is, a trace of the blemish of desire,
and it too touched the great ones,
as our Sages, of blessed memory, said:
"And Miriam and Aharon spoke against Moshe";
and that is a trace of the blemish of honor;
in the very holiest in Yisrael,
from our Rebbe of Izbitza, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
of the greatest tzaddikim in every generation.
And yet despite all this it says:
"And the Ark of the covenant of Hashem
to seek out a resting place for them":
for even though there is a strengthening in the soul
of a trace of the three bad attributes,
from the side of the leaven in the dough,
through the power of the Torah,
which is the Ark of the covenant of Hashem,
to subdue the three aspects mentioned above,
to seek out a resting place for them."
alludes to a person's conduct always,
all the days of his life in this world;
in which he has labor and battle
to refine the three attributes mentioned above,
And "the Ark of the covenant of Hashem traveled before them"
this is the aspect of the holiness of Shabbos,
all three of these attributes in holiness;
and "were it not that the Holy One, blessed be He, helps him,
"to seek out a resting place for them":
for through the aspect of the holiness of
"And it shall be on the day Hashem gives you rest
from your sorrow and from your trembling
with which you were made to serve";
and it says in the holy Zohar
that it alludes to the Shabbos day.
to the three blemishes mentioned above:
and the wrath of the gall;
in the desires of his soul
in subjugation and servitude to desire;
with even half his desire in hand";
"One who loves money will not be sated with money";
and this is the meaning of
with which you were made to serve."
alludes to the blemish of honor and pride;
for from this branches out sadness in the heart;
as we heard something like this
from our master, teacher and Rebbe
of Izbitza, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
"The wine on its owner's shoulder leaps,"
through this the wine betrays him,
so that sadness is born from it in the heart
and this is the opposite of the wine
And through the rest of Shabbos
that is, from honor, jealousy and desire,
